title: Eulogy For TikTok/ Hark, It Is Risen
subtitle: Eulogy for a Service restored from death.
body_html:
One of the problems of our modern era when it comes to satire is that things changed so fast, it's hard to knock out a good piece of parody poetry before the world has changed all over again. It's hard to know what to make fun of! What follows is a poem I wrote when TikTok was banned, but before I could publish it, it was restored, and here I am with a perfectly good parody poem, and reality has changed around me. I decided instead of letting it languish, that I was just going publish it today, as a reminder of the power of Shakespeare satire poetry to mildly amuse, even in the age of short form video.

Subscribe now

Friends, Influencers, content creators, lend me your eyes;

I come to uninstall TikTok, not to praise it.

The content that men create lives after them;

The hot takes are oft interred with their banned accounts;

So let it be with TikTok. The masculine Zuck

Hath told you TikTok was ambitious:

If it were so, it was a real problem,

And grievously hath Alito uphel’d it.

Here, under leave of Zuck and the rest–

For Zuck is an honourable man;

So are they all, all honourable men–

Come I to speak in TikTok’s funeral.

It was my friend, faithful and helped me blow up:

But Alito it was a national security threat ;

And Alito is an honourable man, In that he's a Supreme Court justice.

The Tok hath brought many captives viewers home to my content

Whose cross promotions with Temu for “viral drinks Fridges” did the bank account fill:

Did this in TikTok seem threatening?

When that the poor have spent their cash on cheap imports from China, Zuck hath wept

Trade imbalances should be made of sterner stuff:

Yet Alito says it was problematic;

And Alito is an honourable man.

You all did see that among the youth

I thrice noted TikTok was the king of social,

Which thrice the platform did deny: was this ambition?

Yet Alito says it was dangerous;

And, sure, he is an honourable man.

I speak not to disprove what the Justices ruled,

But here I am to speak what I do know.

You all did love short form video once, not without cause:

What drives you, to mourn for its possible ban?

O judgment! thou art fled to skibidi toilet,

And men—as well as blue sweatpants girls, have lost their followings. Bear with me;

My heart is in the coffin there with TikTok,

And I must pause till it gets reinstated by the grace of Trump, and my following, thusly restored.

Thanks for reading.
